calibration.overall_assessment: High-confidence predictions (top 10% and top 25%) improved significantly, but overall calibration degraded. The +250_plus underdog odds band experienced catastrophic collapse with accuracy dropping from 47.1% to 22.2% and ROI turning from +0.92 to -0.16.

key_insights: Overall accuracy degraded significantly (-3.03%), falling from 68.01% to 64.98%
All overall metrics degraded: Brier score (+0.0023), AUC (-0.0256), log loss (+0.004)
Top 25% accuracy improved substantially (+5.48%), rising from 79.19% to 84.67%
Top 10% accuracy also improved (+3.34%), rising from 83.33% to 86.67%
Underdog accuracy degraded significantly (-3.52%), falling from 68.31% to 64.79%
Underdog ROI collapsed in the bottom 75% confidence bucket (-0.30 delta), falling from 0.33 to 0.03
Top 10% underdog ROI improved (+0.16), rising from 1.21 to 1.37, but sample size is very small (n=9)
The +250_plus underdog odds band experienced catastrophic collapse: accuracy dropped 24.9 percentage points (47.1% to 22.2%), ROI dropped 1.08 (+0.92 to -0.16)
Favorites accuracy degraded (-2.58%), falling from 67.74% to 65.16%
The intended fix to restore baseline performance by adding constraints at 0 did NOT achieve its expected effect
The model shows extreme polarization: excellent high-confidence performance but catastrophic degradation across most other segments
change_summary: Restore 3 removed features to schema and constraints with 0 constraint to fix validation error and restore baseline performance

expected_vs_actual.expected: Restore baseline performance with underdog accuracy returning to ~68%, ROI to ~0.33, and overall accuracy to ~68%
expected_vs_actual.actual: Failed to restore baseline. Overall accuracy is 64.98% (expected ~68%), underdog accuracy is 64.79% (expected ~68%), underdog bottom 75% ROI is 0.03 (expected ~0.33), +250_plus accuracy is 22.2% (expected ~47%)
expected_vs_actual.outcome: The change did NOT achieve its intended effect. Performance degraded further rather than restoring baseline.
